title: Strixhaven: School of Mages Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Moriana
entities.description: A Mage Tower coach who urges students to win the crowd as well as the game.

entities.name: Extus
entities.description: Oriq overlord who sought vengeance on Strixhaven and recruited mage-students through infiltrators.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A faction thirsting for the forbidden secrets of the past, led by Extus.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The school of mages on Arcavios whose halls Extus sought to destroy.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane that holds Strixhaven and has mystical wonders.

entities.name: Archaics
entities.description: Ancient beings sought by mages for boundless knowledge of history and magic, given only in cryptic metaphors.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A character who saved the speaker in a confrontation with the past.

entities.name: Rowan
entities.description: A character who drew on the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl and, with Will, brought down the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Will
entities.description: A character whose quick thinking meshed with Rowan's power to bring down the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A creature brought down by Will and Rowan.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: The dragons who brought the Blood Age to an end and are served by the Dragonsguard.

entities.name: Blood Age
entities.description: An age of war on Arcavios ended by the Founder Dragons.

entities.name: Blex
entities.description: A pest who is far from typical.

entities.name: Jadzi
entities.description: Someone one finds simply by wandering.

entities.name: Shaile
entities.description: Dean of Radiance who encourages a student.

entities.name: Lisette
entities.description: Dean of the Root who speaks of the brief blessing of a flower.

entities.name: Needledeep
entities.description: A student who promised his final project would be his biggest yet.

entities.name: Professor Onyx
entities.description: A professor who warns that demons offer power at a ruinous price.

entities.name: Zhaer
entities.description: Professor of biophilosophy who describes stepping into the star arch.

entities.name: Quandrix
entities.description: A college of Strixhaven whose students learn metaphysics and disagree with the concept of enough.

entities.name: Witherbloom
entities.description: A college of Strixhaven whose students see death as opportunity.

events.summary: Extus, seeking vengeance, has infiltrators recruit promising mage-students from the halls he sought to destroy.
events.quote: His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

events.summary: Will's quick thinking and Rowan's raw power bring down the Blood Avatar.
events.quote: Will's quick thinking meshed with Rowan's raw power to bring down the Blood Avatar.

events.summary: Rowan draws on the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl while Will gasps.
events.quote: Will gasped as Rowan drew from the raw power of the Strixhaven Snarl.

events.summary: The Founder Dragons are said to have brought the Blood Age to an end.
events.quote: The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end.

relations.quote: To exact his vengeance, Extus needed followers.
The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end.
